name: wellness: a resting-HR-only crossing and a daylight-only crossing each produce their own fact
cell: rest / all sources / never started / base
comment: Resting HR 55 on 10-10..10-19 (10 values), 61 on 10-20: baseline 55.0, 61 >= 60 -> fact resting_hr above. HRV 50 on every day including 10-20 (50 > 40, no crossing).
Daylight 45 on 10-10..10-18, 12 on 10-19, 45 on 10-20. 10-19: baseline = 9 x 45 / 9 = 45.0, 12 < 20 -> fact daylight_min below (HRV and RHR ordinary that day).
10-20 daylight baseline = (9 x 45 + 12) / 10 = 417 / 10 = 41.7; 45 >= 20 so daylight does not cross; the fact is the resting HR one.
10-16: 6 prior values of resting HR (10-10..10-15) -> baseline null; 10-17: 7 -> 55.0.
